_doc: Maps each body file to its Shopify notification admin name, page-level title/badge/preheader, and the Shopify admin-path segment used in /email_templates/<adminPath>/edit. Body files live in scripts/shopify-templates/bodies/<key>.html and use the <od-*> macros of app/lib/email-shell.ts. Generated templates land in scripts/shopify-templates/out/<key>.html. phase 1 = has a body and is pasted; phase 2 = Shopify's default stays live (its default carries a link or label variable we cannot verify: return created, return approved, draft order invoice, order invoice, payment reminder, order payment receipt, customer email change).
